name: Kanojo wa Warui Ko, Hidoi Ko, Minikui Ko
original_name: 彼女は悪い子、酷い子、醜い子
source:
Love can be cruel.
I fell for the coolest guy in class. My best friend's cheering me on, but there's no way he could like me back. It was a losing game from the very moment I started liking him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21904]Freem![/url]]
